claim: PayPal's Agent Ready page names item not received claims as a dispute type its built-in Seller Protection covers for agentic-initiated transactions.
quote: Built-in Seller Protection for eligible agentic-initiated transactions helps guard against unauthorized transactions and item-not-received claims.
source_name: PayPal, Agent-Ready Payments for AI Agents

claim: PayPal's Agentic Commerce Pulse Report, a study of 498 US merchants (survey run Feb 23 to Mar 3, 2026), finds nearly two thirds of merchants call a standardized liability framework, modeled on card-not-present chargeback rules, urgently needed.
quote: Nearly two-thirds of all merchants surveyed say a standardized liability framework
source_name: PayPal, What merchants really think about agentic commerce

claim: Worldpay states that no liability shift exists yet for agentic payments.
source_name: Worldpay, Agentic commerce liability is still being written
date: Read 2026-11-12 (page shows no publication date; July 2026 not confirmed)

claim: PayPal's US dispute fee is USD 15.00 standard and USD 30.00 high volume, and the Standard Dispute Fee is waived for inquiries not escalated to a claim or resolved between buyer and seller.
quote: The Standard Dispute Fee will be waived for Inquiries in the PayPal Resolution Center that aren't escalated to a claim
source_name: PayPal merchant fees (US) and PayPal help article on the Dispute Fee
date: Fee table page shows last updated 2026-11-04; read 2026-11-12
